note: All guide text is written in our own words. Every step cites a source number from app/data/sources.json. Disputes show both versions and our call.

trophies.guide: The last trophy on the list. It pops automatically the moment your other 54 trophies are done, so there is no trick to it — it is a summary of everything else here. Plan around the one missable and the long 100% checklist, and this lands on its own.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

steps.t: Earn the other 54 trophies. The platinum unlocks as soon as the 54th lands — no separate task needed [1][2].
Expect about 200 hours and a difficulty of roughly 4 out of 10. The time is the boss, not the skill [2][10].
Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation before the point of no return. It is the only trophy with a possible missable attached [2][11].
Work through the 100% checklist as you go: progress made during the story counts toward it [10][11].

trophies.guide: An early story trophy that lands once the Gone Fishing mission is finished. Unmissable, no special requirement — just play the story.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

steps.t: Play the opening story until the Gone Fishing mission is done. The trophy pops when it ends [1][8].
No side task needed — this is a pure story beat, not a collectible or skill check [1][2].
If you are chasing the Chapter 1 missables, finish them before the point of no return later in the chapter [1][8].
It is a hidden trophy on PSN, so it stays secret until you earn it [1][2].

disputes.a: The official description says "Complete Chapter 1" [1][8].
disputes.b: OutputLag and TimeSaver say chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter, not on the last cutscene [8][11].
disputes.call: Expect the pop when Chapter 2's first mission starts, not when the Chapter 1 finale cutscene ends.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. The trophy can appear a little late: several guides note chapter trophies trigger when the next chapter begins, so do not panic if it does not fire on the final cutscene.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

steps.t: Play through every Chapter 1 story mission to the end of the chapter [1][2].
If it has not popped by the last cutscene, start the first mission of Chapter 2 — chapter trophies can trigger there [8][11].
Before you leave Chapter 1, clear the missables: balcony meditation, Shirley's tasks, Jason's cash and the parrot-cage stash [2][9].
Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter. There are 15 manual slots plus one autosave, and no New Game+ [2][10].
Chapter 1 also sets up your first collectibles: save the money you want to keep into BuckMe family savings before the end [10][11].

disputes.a: GMTreks lists this trophy as "Complete Chapter 3" [13].
disputes.b: The official description says "Complete Chapter 2" [1][8].
disputes.call: The official list wins. GMTreks numbers every chapter trophy one chapter higher than the official list.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. This is the chapter where two-character play opens up, and it is also where several timed and optional things live — the Starlet Motel safehouse, the Delights Cabaret pool opponent and Kenton's return all sit here.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

steps.t: Play through Chapter 2's story missions to the end of the chapter [1][2].
Enter the Starlet Motel safehouse finale with at least $15,000 on hand so the safehouse stays yours [2][9].
Beat the Delights Cabaret pool opponent in Chapter 2 before the Checking Out mission — the opponent is gone until the club reopens later [9][12].
Your home console is off limits for most of Chapter 2 and comes back in Chapter 3. Do the arcade trophies before or after, not during [2][9].
If the trophy has not popped by the last cutscene, start Chapter 3 — it can trigger on the next chapter's first mission [8][11].

disputes.a: GMTreks lists this trophy as "Complete Chapter 4" [13].
disputes.b: The official description says "Complete Chapter 3" [1][8].
disputes.call: The official list wins. GMTreks numbers every chapter trophy one chapter higher than the official list.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. The side-character strands open up here — Andy, Randy and Tyrone all start in this chapter — and the Key Cloner mission unlocks vehicle registration, which several later trophies depend on.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

steps.t: Play through Chapter 3's story missions to the end of the chapter [1][2].
Meet Andy (Lucia only), Randy and Tyrone as their strands open in Chapter 3 — starting them early saves backtracking later [2][8].
The hourglass mission "Race Against Yago" appears in Chapter 3. Do it the same day it shows up; timed missions can expire [2][9].
Finish the Key Cloner mission so you can register vehicles — it is the gate for the vehicle trophies [2][8].
If the trophy has not popped by the last cutscene, start Chapter 4 — it can trigger on the next chapter's first mission [8][11].

disputes.a: GMTreks lists this trophy as "Complete Chapter 5" [13].
disputes.b: The official description says "Complete Chapter 4" [1][8].
disputes.call: The official list wins. GMTreks numbers every chapter trophy one chapter higher than the official list.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. The final mission sits in this chapter, and the optional vault mission that unlocks two trophies happens here too — do not skip the cafe wait.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

steps.t: Play through Chapter 4's story missions to the end of the chapter [1][2].
When the optional "That's Where The Money Is... (Wait at the Cafe)" appears, wait at the cafe — it opens the vault mission behind two trophies [2][8].
Keep a manual save before the final mission. There is more than one ending, and the ending can limit which character you can still play [2][9].
Finish any both-character trophies before the finale if you can — they are safest while you still control both characters [2][10].
If the trophy has not popped by the last cutscene, start Chapter 5 — it can trigger on the next chapter's first mission [8][11].

disputes.a: PowerPyx places the final mission, "Starting From Zero", in Chapter 4 [2].
disputes.b: Game-Checklists puts the final mission in Chapter 5 [12].
disputes.call: Follow the official list, which names no chapter for the final mission. Save before it either way, because the ending matters.

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. The guides disagree on which chapter it sits in, so do not trust the chapter number — trust the save you made before it. There is more than one ending, and your choices and play style shape which one you get.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

steps.t: Play the story to the final mission, "Starting From Zero", and complete it [1][2].
Make a manual save before the final mission. More than one ending exists, and the ending can limit which character you can still play [2][9].
Finish both-character trophies before the finale where possible — the ending may restrict who you control afterwards [9][12].
After the story, free roam stays open, so the 100% checklist and all remaining trophies are still doable [2][10].
The trophy pops when the final mission completes [1][8].

trophies.guide: Finish the Breakfast Run mission in Chapter 2. This is also the moment two-character play is said to open — guides differ on whether it is this mission or Coffee Break, so expect switching to become available right around here.
trophies.name: Trust

steps.t: Play Chapter 2 until the Breakfast Run mission is complete [1][2].
Try switching characters after the mission. OutputLag says switching opens right after Breakfast Run, PowerPyx says after Coffee Break — either way it is right here [2][8].
Once you can switch, play as both characters regularly. Meditation, collectibles and several trophies need both [11][12].
No side requirement — a story beat that pops on completion [1][2].

trophies.guide: Finish The Cartel Heist mission. A straight story trophy — play the mission, complete it, and the trophy lands.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

steps.t: Play the story until The Cartel Heist mission appears and complete it [1][2].
No side requirement — the trophy pops on mission completion [1][8].
Heists feed the Marked Bills economy: $250,000 laundered through contacts is a separate trophy, so keep your fence contacts in mind [2][10].
It is a hidden trophy, so it stays secret on PSN until earned [1][2].

trophies.guide: Finish the Child's Play mission. A straight story trophy — play the mission and complete it.
trophies.name: Family Matters

steps.t: Play the story until the Child's Play mission appears and complete it [1][2].
No side requirement — the trophy pops on mission completion [1][8].
Story missions like this one also progress the 100% checklist's story task counts [2][10].
It is a hidden trophy, so it stays secret on PSN until earned [1][2].

trophies.guide: Finish the Headliners mission. A straight story trophy — play the mission and complete it.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

steps.t: Play the story until the Headliners mission appears and complete it [1][2].
No side requirement — the trophy pops on mission completion [1][8].
Story missions like this one also progress the 100% checklist's story task counts [2][10].
It is a hidden trophy, so it stays secret on PSN until earned [1][2].

trophies.guide: Finish the VCIA Takedown mission. A straight story trophy — play the mission and complete it.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

steps.t: Play the story until the VCIA Takedown mission appears and complete it [1][2].
No side requirement — the trophy pops on mission completion [1][8].
Story missions like this one also progress the 100% checklist's story task counts [2][10].
It is a hidden trophy, so it stays secret on PSN until earned [1][2].

trophies.guide: Finish the Operation Savage Glory mission in Chapter 5. This is the late-story mission that closes the Snow Storm trophy — a story beat, not a side task.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

steps.t: Play the story until the Operation Savage Glory mission appears and complete it [1][2].
No side requirement — the trophy pops on mission completion [1][8].
Keep a manual save before the final mission, which follows soon after [2][10].
Finish both-character trophies before the finale if you can — the ending can limit who you control [2][9].
It is a hidden trophy, so it stays secret on PSN until earned [1][2].

disputes.a: PowerPyx and KeenGamer call this the hardest trophy, because of the sheer time [2][10].
disputes.b: GMTreks says The Shootist and Sneakthief are among the trickiest [13].
disputes.call: Hardest by time: A Long Road. Hardest by skill: The Shootist. Both are right — they measure different things.

trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. This is the long one — the checklist only appears after the story (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion), and it covers story tasks, money, collectibles, exploration, weapons, races and activities. Progress made during the story counts, so do not leave it all for the end.
trophies.name: A Long Road

steps.t: Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story to see the full checklist. Progress during the story counts [2][10].
Story tasks: Gang Ops 39/39, Bank Jobs 22/22, Payday Loan Jobs 7/7, Bank Vaults 8/8, Smash 'N' Grabs 34/35, Stick Ups 50/91 [3][10].
Money tasks: Narcotics $100,000, Jewelry $100,000, Marked Bills $250,000, Vehicles fenced $200,000 [3][10].
Collections: Kenton sets 5/7, Card sets 15/18, WAiNK 100 [3][10].
Exploration: Underwater Discoveries 33/33, Cocaine Flamingos 100/125, Meditations 15/18, Magazines, Books and Comics 30/34 (27 magazines + 7 book swaps) [3][10].
Style and music: Unique Playlists 2/2, Discovered Styles 70/79 [3][10].
Vehicles: Base vehicles 200/277 [3][10].
Weapons: Standard Issue Weapons 50/66 — 53 guns, 9 melee, 4 explosives [3][10].
Wildlife: Animals studied 100/255 [3][10].
Races: Unique Races 30/40 won, Race Challenge Gold 10/13, Drone Trials 42/42, Shooting Range Gold 42/42 [3][10].
Activities: Video Games 4/4, Pool 5/7, Mini Golf 2/3, Basketball 90/100, Stunts 300/397, Challenges 70/80 [3][10].
Bret's Target Decks 15/15 and Optional Tasks 100 round out the list [3][10].

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. There are 397 stunts in total across four types, so the trophy needs about two thirds of them — the 100% checklist wants 300. Track your count under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion > Stunts.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

steps.t: The 397 total breaks down as 130 stunt jumps, 202 under bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps [2][10].
The trophy needs 250; the 100% checklist needs 300. Do the trophy first, keep going for the checklist [2][3].
Track your count under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion > Stunts [2][10].
Stunt jumps: find the ramps and jumps around Leonida and land cleanly [2][10].
Under bridges: fly or drive under bridges — planes and boats work for the low ones [2][10].
Knife flights: fly a plane low and sideways through tight gaps [2][10].
Base jumps: jump from high spots with a parachute and land on the target [2][10].
Any vehicle works for most stunts; use fast bikes and planes to cover ground quickly [2][3].

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. A sampler trophy — one go at fishing, hunting, golf, the shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt, and it pops.
trophies.name: Master of None

steps.t: Fishing: fish once, anywhere there is water [2][10].
Hunting: hunt once with Bret's gear or a rifle in the wild [2][10].
Golf: play a round of golf once [2][10].
Shooting Ranges: run one shooting range challenge [2][10].
Pool: play a game of pool once [2][10].
Basketball: shoot some hoops once [2][10].
Video Game: finish one arcade or home-console game [2][10].
Race and stunt: win a car race, a race challenge or a Top Fun drone race, and perform one stunt [2][10].

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.

disputes.a: GMTreks says gold medals are needed "across 12 ranges", and PowerPyx's main guide links to "All 12 Shooting Range Locations" [13][2].
disputes.b: PowerPyx's shooting-range guide says 12 challenges at 2 ranges, and OutputLag says two shooting ranges with 42 gold medals between them [6][8].
disputes.call: Two ranges, twelve challenges, 42 gold medals. "12 ranges" is a wording error in the main guide's link title.

disputes.a: PowerPyx calls the gold medals "relatively easy" [6].
disputes.b: GMTreks calls The Shootist one of the trickiest trophies, and TimeSaver says the only skill wall in the list is here [13][11].
disputes.call: Expect the Master-tier challenges to be hard. Play as Lucia at Griffin and build your multiplier before going for headshots.

trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 12 shooting range challenges — 42 gold medals in total across 2 ranges. The ranges disagree in the guides (some say 12 ranges), but the detailed guide is clear: Griffin in north-west Vice City and Rodgers Ranch in north-east Port Gellhorn. This is the skill gate of the list.
trophies.name: The Shootist

steps.t: Two ranges, twelve challenges, 42 gold medals total: Griffin (6 challenges x 3 medals = 18) and Rodgers Ranch (6 x 4 = 24) [6][8].
Griffin is in north-west Vice City. Play as Lucia there — she runs faster between targets [6][2].
Rodgers Ranch is in north-east Port Gellhorn. Each of its 6 courses has 4 medal tiers [6][2].
Buy the Waiver Pass for $5 at the clerk to mark the challenges, and rent a weapon for $10 if you need one [6][2].
Build your score multiplier with body shots first, then go for headshots. Missing a shot resets the multiplier [6][2].
Finishing or quitting a challenge gives a permanent Focus increase — useful for the Gunslinger trophy too [6][2].
The Master Hunting Range at Rodgers Ranch is the hardest: you cannot miss a single shot [6][2].
Buff your Focus before a run with a drink, food, or washing your face and showering [6][2].

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location has 3 time trials: beat par on the first two to unlock the third, and the third only needs a finish. The trophy needs one win per location; 100% wants all 42 trials.
trophies.name: Top Fun

steps.t: 42 races across 14 locations, 3 trials each. The trophy needs one win per location; 100% needs all 42 [2][7].
Races are marked with a blue icon when you are within 100 metres. Use the map filter Activities > Top Fun Drones [2][7].
Beat par on the first two trials to unlock the third. The third trial only needs a finish [7][10].
Hold the left stick forward for max speed and avoid crashing — a crash costs more time than a careful line [2][7].
Dalton Island is only reachable by boat or aircraft, so plan a trip there instead of driving [7][10].
14 locations: Hamlet, Watson Bay, Capri, Buckskin Swamp, Balsero, Downtown, Dalton Island, Vice Beach, Waning Sands, Ambrosia, Port Gellhorn, Draper Island, Moreau Sawmill, Millport [2][10].
You only need to beat par on 28 of the 42 trials to unlock everything [7][10].

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Car races, race challenges and Top Fun drone races all count — the key word is different, so repeat wins on the same race do not add up.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

steps.t: Win 20 different races. A win on a race you already won does not count again [2][10].
Car races, race challenges and Top Fun drone races all count toward the 20 [2][10].
The 100% checklist wants 30 of 40 unique races won, so keep racing past 20 for the checklist [3][10].
Use the map filters to find race starts you have not tried yet [2][10].
Drone race wins count here too, so the 14 Top Fun locations are an easy chunk of the 20 [2][10].
Track progress under the 100% checklist's race counts [2][10].

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal appears after the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal), and his challenge is west of Key Lento. Fishing also raises your Focus, so it doubles as training for the combat trophies.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

steps.t: Finish the Chapter 1 mission "Feng Shui (Meet Cal)" first — Cal's challenge only appears after it [2][8].
Find Cal's fishing challenge west of Key Lento [2][8].
Fishing is timing and tension: reel steadily, ease off when the line strains, and keep the fish in the zone [2][10].
If you lose, challenge him again — there is no limit on attempts [2][10].
Fishing raises your Focus permanently, which helps the Gunslinger trophy [2][10].
The trophy pops as soon as you beat Cal [1][2].

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. The 100% checklist wants 4 video games, so this trophy is the first of four. Your home console is off limits for most of Chapter 2 and comes back in Chapter 3 — do the arcade games before or after that stretch.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

steps.t: Find an arcade and finish any one arcade game all the way through [2][10].
Your home console is off limits for most of Chapter 2 and returns in Chapter 3 — use the arcade machines meanwhile [2][9].
The 100% checklist wants 4 video games, so play three more for the checklist [3][10].
Any arcade game counts; pick the one you find easiest and finish it [2][10].
Arcade games are scattered across Leonida — check the map's activity icons [2][10].
The trophy pops when the game ends [1][2].

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy is Lucia-only and starts in Chapter 3 in Belville — five quests, ending with Puff Puff Pass. Start early and finish before the finale so the ending cannot cut the strand off.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

steps.t: Andy is Lucia-only and starts in Chapter 3 in Belville [2][8].
Quest 1-3: Climbing the Cellerichain 1, 2 and 3 [2][10].
Quest 4: Pay the Cellerica Fee [2][10].
Quest 5: Peach! [2][10].
Quest 6: Read the Label [2][10].
Final quest: Puff Puff Pass — complete it for the trophy [2][10].
Finish the strand before the final mission. Single-character strands are safest while you still control both characters [2][9].

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton starts in Chapter 1 after Island Dreams, vanishes for a while, then comes back in Chapters 2–3 — he is not missable. Dive 7 shipwrecks with a metal detector and bring up the purple-chest treasures.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

steps.t: Meet Kenton in Chapter 1 after the Island Dreams mission. His KR icon sits at Key Lento [2][9].
Dive 7 shipwrecks with a metal detector and collect the treasures, marked by purple chest icons [2][10].
Kenton is temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapters 2-3. He is NOT missable [2][9].
Calling Brian as Jason later in Chapter 2 speeds his return [2][9].
Track progress under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees [2][10].
The 100% checklist wants 5 of 7 Kenton sets, so keep diving past the trophy [3][10].
Finish his final mission for the trophy [2][10].

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy starts after the Chapter 2 Coffee Break mission at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County — five quests, ending with Hometown Heroes. Finish before the finale.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

steps.t: Billy starts after the Chapter 2 Coffee Break mission at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County [2][8].
Quest 1: Thrillbillies [2][10].
Quest 2: Twist Wrist Smash Grab [2][10].
Quest 3: Mall Rats [2][10].
Quest 4: The Impaler [2][10].
Final quest: Hometown Heroes — complete it for the trophy [2][10].
Finish the strand before the final mission. Single-character strands are safest while you still control both characters [2][9].

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.

disputes.a: OutputLag and Game-Checklists warn that the timed "Race Against Yago" mission may put Strangers & Freaks at risk if it expires [9][12].
disputes.b: PowerPyx says open-world Strangers & Freaks strands are still there after the story [2].
disputes.call: Do the race the day it appears. Do not gamble a trophy on the hope that the strand survives.

disputes.a: PowerPyx lists confirmed counting strands as Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete, and says more strangers are yet to be discovered [2].
disputes.b: TimeSaver says Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's strands have their own trophies and do not count toward the 8 [11].
disputes.call: Count only the standalone strangers. Andy, Billy, Tyrone, Moses, Yasmani and Eddie have their own trophies or do not count.

trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. The counting strands are the standalone ones — Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed, with more undiscovered. The named side characters with their own trophies do not count. Watch the timed Yago race: do it the day it appears.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

steps.t: You need 8 complete stranger strands. Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed counting [2][10].
Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's strands have their own trophies and do NOT count toward the 8 [11][2].
Moses, Yasmani and Eddie do not count either [2][10].
PowerPyx notes more strangers are yet to be discovered — explore and check the map for stranger icons [2][10].
Do the timed "Race Against Yago" mission in Chapter 3 the same day it appears. Missing it may put this trophy at risk [9][12].
Finish stranger strands before the final mission if you can — the ending can limit which character you play [2][9].
Strands are spread across the state, so work them into your free-roam exploration [2][10].
The trophy pops when the 8th strand completes [2][10].

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy starts after the Chapter 3 Clonin' Keys Makin' GS mission — he wants 16 sports cars delivered, including the Granforma Zorrusso from that same mission. The cars are commonest around east Vice City, Vice Beach and Ocean Beach.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

steps.t: Randy starts after the Chapter 3 mission "Clonin' Keys Makin' GS" (Key Cloner). His RK icon is in west Vice City [2][8].
Randy wants 16 sports cars from his wish list. The Granforma Zorrusso is delivered during the Key Cloner mission itself [2][10].
Sports cars are commonest around east Vice City, Vice Beach and Ocean Beach [2][10].
Deliver each car to Randy as you find one — do not stockpile and forget [2][10].
Keep a checklist of the 16 cars so you do not deliver the same model twice [2][10].
Finish his final mission for the trophy [2][10].
Finish the strand before the final mission. Single-character strands are safest while you still control both characters [2][9].

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone is Jason-only and starts after the Chapter 3 mission Here Kitty Kitty — destroy Synthetic Labs across the map, then take on Spin On This. Finish before the finale.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

steps.t: Tyrone is Jason-only and starts after the Chapter 3 mission Here Kitty Kitty [2][8].
Destroy Synthetic Labs across Leonida. Each one you take out moves the strand forward [2][10].
After enough labs are destroyed, Tyrone gives the final mission, Spin On This [2][10].
Complete Spin On This for the trophy [2][10].
Finish the strand before the final mission. Single-character strands are safest while you still control both characters [2][9].
Tyrone's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks — it has its own trophy [2][10].

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.

disputes.a: PowerPyx says it is "currently unclear" whether the Chapter 1 meditation is required for the trophy [4][2].
disputes.b: OutputLag says the trophy "may still unlock without it" [9].
disputes.call: Do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save. One missed meditation is not worth replaying the chapter.

disputes.a: PowerPyx's author had 17 of 18 before the final meditation and 18 of 18 after it, and notes the final meditation "might count as +2" [4].
disputes.b: KeenGamer lists 18 spots, one meditation each [10].
disputes.call: Count on 18 separate meditations. Treat the Chapter 1 one as required.

trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 meditations across 10 spot locations. Each spot counts twice if you meditate there with both characters, and the final spot only appears after all the others. The first spot is Jason's balcony in Chapter 1, and it is the only possible missable in the whole list.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

steps.t: Spot 1 — Jason's House. Meditate on the balcony in Chapter 1, before the point of no return. This is the one possible missable [4][2].
Each spot counts as 2 meditations if you do it with both characters. Switch after Chapter 2's Coffee Break to play as both [4][10].
Spot 2 — Smooth Sand: sandbar off the west coast of Capri, Mariana County [4][10].
Spot 3 — Swamp: dock in Buckskin Swamp, Kelly County [4][10].
Spot 4 — Worn Stone: Emerald River, Camp Moonflower, Kelly County [4][10].
Spot 5 — Red Rocks: Manifest Canyon, Kelly County [4][10].
Spot 6 — Water Wheel: ruined paper mill south of Moreau, Lummox County [4][10].
Spot 7 — Jutting Cliff: Mount Kalaga National Park tower overlooking the mine, Lummox County [4][10].
Spot 8 — Waterfall: north-west of Tallaloko, Lummox County [4][10].
Spot 9 — Seaside: rocky outcrop east of Waning Sands, Leonard County [4][10].
Spot 10 — Ascent Mountain: stone circle at the Mount Kalaga peak, Lummox County. It is only marked after you complete all the others [4][10].
Track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations, or use the map filter Exploration > Meditate Around Leonida [4][10].
The 100% checklist wants 15 of 18 meditations; the trophy wants all 18 [3][10].

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.

disputes.a: PowerPyx says it is "still undergoing confirmation which animal exactly unlocks this" [2].
disputes.b: KeenGamer describes it as hunting a unique animal through Bret's target decks [10].
disputes.call: Work through Bret's 15 target decks. The unique animal comes from his questline, not from random hunting.

trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret is Jason-only and starts after the Chapter 2 Coffee Break mission in Lummox County — Veteran Hunted, with the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle. A clean head or heart shot gives a pristine kill, which is what his target decks reward.
trophies.name: Fair Game

steps.t: Bret is Jason-only and starts after the Chapter 2 Coffee Break mission in Lummox County (Veteran Hunted) [2][10].
Use the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle for hunting [2][10].
A clean head or heart shot gives a pristine kill — that is what Bret's target decks reward [2][10].
Work through Bret's 15 target decks. The 100% checklist wants all 15 [3][10].
Which animal exactly unlocks the trophy is still unconfirmed by the guides — follow Bret's questline, not random hunts [2][10].
Finish the strand before the final mission. Single-character strands are safest while you still control both characters [2][9].

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 sets and 480 unique cards in total — the trophy needs 3 sets, the 100% checklist needs 15 (at least 372 cards). Cards hide in buildings and in yellow phone boxes and tool boxes outside. Duplicates do not count, and selling a card does not remove it from your collection.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

steps.t: 18 sets, 480 unique cards. The trophy needs 3 sets; the 100% checklist needs 15 sets, at least 372 cards [5][10].
Cards are found in buildings (on surfaces and walls) and outside in yellow phone boxes and tool boxes [5][10].
Colour versions (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Red, Blue, Purple) count as unique cards. Duplicates do not count twice [5][10].
You cannot farm cards by purchasing them — they must be found [5][10].
Smallest sets first: Backyard Wrestling has 12 cards, Delights Dancers 18 — fastest route to 3 sets [5][10].
Cards can be sold at Pawn Shops for $20 to $1,000+, but selling does not remove them from Collections [5][10].
Set sizes: most sets have 24 cards; Jack of Hearts, Nine1Nine, Legends of Ratface, Right Wing and Ed Comics have 36 [5][10].

disputes.a: PowerPyx breaks the 100 down as 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher Tags [2].
disputes.b: KeenGamer just counts 100 scans, with no breakdown [10].
disputes.call: Scan everything — landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and tags. The breakdown is PowerPyx's, the target of 100 is agreed.

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK is the phone scanning feature — point it at landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and tags around Leonida. The 100% checklist also wants 100, so the trophy and the checklist finish together.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

steps.t: Open WAiNK on your phone and scan landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and tags as you explore [2][10].
PowerPyx breaks the 100 down as 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher Tags [2][10].
The 100% checklist also wants 100 WAiNK scans, so this trophy and the checklist finish together [3][10].
Scanning also discovers vehicles — it counts toward Whip It Good without needing to drive them [2][10].
Cover the map systematically, county by county, so you do not miss pockets [2][10].
The trophy pops at scan 100 [2][10].
Use the map to find unscanned clusters instead of wandering [2][10].

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. There are 80 challenges in total and the 100% checklist wants 70, so pick the easiest 50 first and keep going for the checklist. Challenges cover driving, flying, shooting, sports and more — spread them across your free roam.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

steps.t: 80 challenges exist in total. The trophy needs 50; the 100% checklist needs 70 [2][10].
Pick the easiest 50 first — driving, flying and sport challenges are the quickest wins [2][10].
Keep going to 70 for the checklist once the trophy pops [3][10].
Track your count under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion > Challenges [2][10].
Challenges are spread across activities, so they finish naturally as you do the other trophies [2][10].
The trophy pops at challenge 50 [2][10].

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.

disputes.a: OutputLag says two-character play opens right after Chapter 2's Breakfast Run [8].
disputes.b: PowerPyx says the characters free-roam together after Chapter 2's Coffee Break [2].
disputes.call: Try switching after Breakfast Run. If it is not available yet, it is after Coffee Break — either way it is the same chapter.

trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Call your partner, commit a crime big enough for 4 stars, then break out of the red heat zone — not just the flashing search area — and stay hidden until the level clears. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia is a reliable hiding spot, and the trophy can pop on its own during the Chapter 4 vault mission.
trophies.name: Hot Together

steps.t: Call your partner (hold right + triangle) so you are together before you start [2][8].
Build a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner beside you [2][10].
Escape the red heat zone itself, not just the flashing search area — the level only clears outside the zone [2][8].
The train tunnel north of Ambrosia is a reliable hiding spot [2][10].
Stay hidden until the 4 stars clear completely [2][8].
You can also get this automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission "That's Where The Money Is..." [2][10].
Do it before the final mission if you can — the ending can limit which character you play [2][9].

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. The trick is keeping the wanted level alive between robberies — do not lose the cops between shops. Three jewelry stores in north Vice City work well once Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs are done, and the trophy can pop about 30 seconds late.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

steps.t: Bring your partner along. Call them before the first robbery [2][8].
Rob 3 shops in a row, back-to-back, without losing your Wanted Level in between [2][8].
Three jewelry stores in north Vice City work well, after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs [2][10].
Break the safe with sticky bombs and move fast to the next shop [2][10].
The pop is delayed — it can take about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop [8][2].
If the wanted level drops between shops, start the chain again [2][10].
Do it before the final mission if you can — the ending can limit which character you play [2][9].

disputes.a: PowerPyx counts 557 vehicles at launch and the 100% page says to scan any 200 of 557 [2][3].
disputes.b: KeenGamer counts 277 base-model vehicles for the 100% checklist [10].
disputes.call: 557 total vehicles, 277 base models. Both are true — variants count toward the 557, base models toward the 277.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. WAiNK scanning counts — you do not need to drive them. The 100% checklist wants 200 base-model vehicles, so keep scanning past 100.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

steps.t: WAiNK scanning counts toward discovery — you do not need to drive a vehicle to discover it [2][10].
The 100% checklist wants 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, so keep scanning past 100 [3][10].
557 vehicles exist at launch in total, counting variants [2][10].
Scan in traffic-heavy areas: Vice City streets, Ocean Beach and around the airports [2][10].
Drive through different counties to find the rarer models [2][10].
The trophy pops at discovery 100 [2][10].

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.

disputes.a: PowerPyx says it "doesn't seem to work on soldiers, police, and civilians" [2].
disputes.b: KeenGamer and OutputLag give no such restriction — any 5 enemies in one Combat Focus [10][8].
disputes.call: Use gang-operation guards. They are confirmed to count, and the operations are easy to find.

trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is L3+R3 — time slows and the purple focus bar drains. Get your Focus to level 4 first (shooting range, golf, pool, fishing and headshots all raise it), then find a group of gang guards and drop five before the bar runs out.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

steps.t: Combat Focus is L3+R3. Time slows while the purple focus bar drains [2][10].
Raise Focus to level 4 first. Shooting range, golf, pool, fishing and headshots all raise it [2][10].
Buff Focus before the attempt with a drink, food, or washing your face and showering [2][10].
Adrenaline extends the focus time — use it if you have it [2][10].
Use gang-operation guards as targets. PowerPyx notes soldiers, police and civilians may not count [2][10].
The Duke 556 rifle works well for this — fast, accurate, good range [2][10].
All 5 takedowns must happen in a single use of Combat Focus. If the bar runs out, try again [2][10].

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — steal the large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge, get it to the runway and take off. Gates E3 and E4 are the easiest. Drive the plane backward out of the gate, line up, and fly at least 1 km away.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

steps.t: Go to VCIA and find the large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge [2][8].
Gates E3 and E4 are the easiest to reach [2][11].
Get upstairs to the cockpit and take control of the plane [2][10].
Drive the plane backward out of the gate, then line up on the runway [2][8].
Take off and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport [2][11].
The trophy pops once you are 1 km clear [2][10].
If security stops you, try again at a different gate or a quieter time [2][10].

trophies.guide: Deal with Rhinos — the tanks — at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of Mariana County. The tanks sit south of the base; enter through the gate or a stunt jump at the south-east entrance. A hidden trophy, so the description gives you nothing — the tanks are the point.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

steps.t: Go to Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of Mariana County [2][8].
The tanks sit south of the base [2][8].
Enter through the gate, or take a stunt jump at the south-east entrance [2][10].
Take on the Rhinos with heavy weapons and cover — they hit hard [2][10].
Bring sticky bombs or a rocket launcher if you have one [2][10].
The trophy pops once you have dealt with the tanks [2][10].

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.

disputes.a: PowerPyx gives a straightforward method: Snap Gun on the back door, backroom safe code, destroy the footage and disable the alarm [2].
disputes.b: GMTreks says this trophy requires careful planning and may need multiple attempts [13].
disputes.call: Follow the Snap Gun method. It is the reliable one — the "multiple attempts" warning is for players who kick the door.

trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. After Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, use the Snap Gun on the back door — kicking the door sets the alarm off. Grab the backroom note with the safe code, destroy the security footage, disable the alarm, and leave clean.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

steps.t: Finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs first — the method needs what they unlock [2][13].
Go to Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds and use the Snap Gun on the back door. Kicking the door sets the alarm off [2][13].
Find the backroom note with the safe code [2][10].
Destroy the security footage and disable the alarm before you leave [2][10].
Open the safe and take the goods [2][10].
Leave without being detected. The trophy pops shortly after you get out [2][10].
If you are spotted, leave and try again — the store is always there [2][13].

disputes.a: PowerPyx says up to $205,000 per bank [2].
disputes.b: TimeSaver gives a range of $65,000 to $205,000 per bank [11].
disputes.call: Expect $65,000 to $205,000 depending on the vault. The big vaults pay the big number.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. The vault mission opens from the Chapter 4 optional "That's Where The Money Is... (Wait at the Cafe)" — tail the security van to the bank, bring your partner to hand off the bag, and get out. Each bank pays $65,000 to $205,000, and the 100% checklist wants 8 vaults.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

steps.t: In Chapter 4, take the optional "That's Where The Money Is... (Wait at the Cafe)" and wait at the cafe [2][8].
Tail the security van to the bank [2][10].
Bring your partner along — they carry the bag out with you [2][10].
Expect 4 stars instantly once the vault is open [2][10].
Each bank pays $65,000 to $205,000 depending on the vault [2][11].
The trophy needs 5 vaults; the 100% checklist needs 8 bank vaults [3][10].
Yasmani tips $10,000 after his 2 Payday Loan quests — do those first for the extra cash [2][10].
Escape the heat after each vault. The trophy pops after the fifth clean escape [2][10].

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The easiest way is during the Chapter 4 vault mission — the same one behind Maximum Withdrawal. Or block a truck near a bank, sticky-bomb the back door, grab the cash and escape the heat radius.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

steps.t: The easiest route is the Chapter 4 vault mission, "That's Where The Money Is..." — an armored truck is part of it [2][8].
Or block an armored truck near a bank and stop it [2][10].
Sticky-bomb the back door to open it. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop [2][10].
Grab the cash and escape the heat radius [2][10].
The trophy pops once you are clear [2][10].
If the truck keeps moving, try a slower stretch of road near a bank [2][10].

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — unfog the whole map. A plane is the fastest way: fly low over every county until no fog is left. Driving works too, but it is much slower.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

steps.t: Unfog the whole map. The trophy pops when no fog is left [2][10].
A plane is the fastest way — fly low over every county [2][10].
Driving works too, but it is much slower [2][10].
Cover the islands and the Keys — they are the easiest to miss [2][10].
Combine this with the WAiNK scans and vehicle discoveries to save time [2][10].

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs, 39 illegal operations in total. The operations are marked with yellow icons on the map. One operation per gang is enough for the trophy; the 100% checklist wants all 39.
trophies.name: Pest Control

steps.t: 9 gangs, 39 illegal operations in total. One operation per gang is enough for the trophy [2][10].
Operations are marked with yellow icons on the map [2][10].
The 100% checklist wants all 39 Gang Ops, so keep clearing them after the trophy [3][10].
Track progress under Progress > Gangs [2][10].
Bring good weapons and a plan — the operations are guarded [2][10].
The trophy pops when the ninth gang's operation is robbed [2][10].

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.

disputes.a: PowerPyx gives an exact method: Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini, drink it next to the bar [2].
disputes.b: KeenGamer says the exact trigger is still being confirmed, and TimeSaver says no trophy guide has a confirmed trigger for it [10][11].
disputes.call: Follow PowerPyx's method — it is the only concrete one. If it does not pop, it may be that no guide has this one right yet.

trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The only concrete method any guide gives is the Ocean View Rooftop Bar: buy an Apple Martini and drink it next to the bar. This is one of five trophies whose exact trigger is still unconfirmed, so treat the method as the best lead, not a guarantee.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

steps.t: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach [2][10].
Buy an Apple Martini at the bar [2][10].
Drink it next to the bar, with the view in front of you [2][10].
The exact trigger is still unconfirmed — KeenGamer and TimeSaver both say no guide has confirmed it [10][11].
If it does not pop, try again on another night or after a different mission — the trigger may be time-gated [2][10].

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.

disputes.a: PowerPyx gives an exact method: take the blue Banshee from the showroom south of Vice City and drive it through the window, after Chapter 3's Key Cloner [2].
disputes.b: KeenGamer says the exact method is still unconfirmed [10].
disputes.call: Follow PowerPyx's method — it is the only concrete one, and it is a GTA III easter egg, which fits the trophy's name.

trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The only concrete method any guide gives is the blue Banshee in the showroom south of Vice City: take it after Chapter 3's Key Cloner mission and drive it straight through the window. The pop is delayed, so do not panic if it does not fire instantly. This is a GTA III easter egg.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

steps.t: Finish Chapter 3's Key Cloner mission first — the showroom method needs it [2][10].
Go to the vehicle showroom south of Vice City [2][10].
Take the blue Banshee from the showroom [2][10].
Drive it straight through the showroom window [2][10].
The pop is delayed — wait a moment after the smash [2][10].
The exact method is still unconfirmed by the other guides, so treat this as the best lead [10][11].

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley in Port Gellhorn. During the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, grab all three valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the north-east corner table, and the safe in the north-east hallway office (sticky bombs open it). The trophy pops after you escape the police. It is NOT missable — the gang-operation icon respawns, so you can go back later.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

steps.t: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley in Port Gellhorn. Best done during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling [2][12].
Valuable 1: the luxury watch in the south-east office [2][12].
Valuable 2: the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the north-east corner table [2][12].
Valuable 3: the safe in the north-east hallway office — open it with sticky bombs [2][12].
Escape the police after the grab. The trophy pops once you are clear [2][12].
It is NOT missable: the gang-operation icon respawns, so you can return later if you leave the safe behind [2][12].
Bowling is also a side activity you can play for fun [2][10].

trophies.guide: Max out Strength for both characters at the same time. Open the Touchpad menu, go to Jason and Lucia, then Strength — the heart icon shows your level. You need a gym membership, and you need to be able to play as both characters, so do this after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. Training together helps: your partner trains alongside you.
trophies.name: Personal Best

steps.t: Wait until after Chapter 2's Coffee Break so you can play as both characters [2][8].
Get a gym membership for both characters [2][10].
Train Strength with both Jason and Lucia until each is at maximum [2][10].
Check progress on the Touchpad: Jason and Lucia, then Strength, heart icon [2][8].
Train together where possible — your partner trains alongside you [2][10].
The trophy pops when both characters are at max Strength at the same time [2][10].
Do it before the final mission if you can — the ending can limit which character you play [2][9].

trophies.guide: Make 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. You can see the count by clicking the trophy itself. Turn on the notifications under Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile so you can see each action land. The profile tiers go Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho and Irredeemable — and Irredeemable is permanent, so do not overdo the violence if you care about the profile.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

steps.t: 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. View the count by clicking the trophy [2][8].
Turn on notifications: Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On, so each action shows up [2][10].
Criminal actions — robberies, thefts, assaults — all count [2][10].
The demon-face icon marks Criminal Profile actions [2][10].
Profile tiers: Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho, Irredeemable [2][10].
Irredeemable is permanent. Do not overdo the violence if you want to keep a lower tier [2][9].
The trophy pops at action 500 [2][10].

disputes.a: PowerPyx's theory: it is related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue in Little Cuba — rob it again [2].
disputes.b: KeenGamer lists it as hidden and unconfirmed, and TimeSaver says no guide has a confirmed trigger [10][11].
disputes.call: Try the Payday Loans store first — it is the only lead anyone has. If nothing pops, this one is genuinely unsolved.

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Nobody knows the exact trigger yet. The only lead any guide has is PowerPyx's theory: the Payday Loans store from the Prologue in Little Cuba — go back and rob it again. One of five unconfirmed trophies; treat the lead as a guess, not a fact.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

steps.t: Go to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue in Little Cuba [2][10].
Rob the store again — the "second time" in the description points at a repeat visit [2][10].
The trigger is unconfirmed. KeenGamer and TimeSaver both say no guide has confirmed it [10][11].
If it does not pop, note what you tried and check back — this one may need a different trigger [2][10].
Do not burn hours on it early. Leave it for the cleanup phase [2][10].

disputes.a: PowerPyx and Beebom give a full method: the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM, a blinking car, a path into the woods, a UFO with a bright blue light [2][14].
disputes.b: KeenGamer says the unlock method is unconfirmed, and TimeSaver says it is not confirmed yet [10][11].
disputes.call: Follow the PowerPyx and Beebom method — it is detailed and specific. If the car is not there, the spawn is random, so come back another night.

disputes.a: PowerPyx says the UFO spawn is slightly random and not a guaranteed spawn [2].
disputes.b: Beebom states the method as definite: Chapter 2 unlocked, 2:00 AM, near the Starlet Motel [14].
disputes.call: Treat it as random. Beebom's method is the right setup, but the car may not appear every night.

disputes.a: PowerPyx places the encounter on the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County [2].
disputes.b: Beebom places it near the Starlet Motel safehouse, east of the busy roads of Port Gellhorn [14].
disputes.call: Search the road north-west of the motel first. The encounter area is small, so both descriptions point to the same stretch.

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The UFO trophy. The method the guides give: at night after 2AM, with Chapter 2 unlocked, go solo to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County. A blinking car with open doors marks the spot — follow the path into the woods to a UFO with a bright blue light. Approach it, the UFO drops an abducted woman, talk to her and offer help, then go back to her car. The UFO comes back and abducts you, and Lucia calls three days later. The spawn is random, so if the car is not there, come back another night.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

steps.t: Unlock Chapter 2 first, then go at night after 2AM [2][14].
Go solo to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County [2][14].
Look for a blinking car with open doors, scattered clothes and static sounds [14][2].
Follow the path into the woods to a UFO with a bright blue light [2][14].
Walk toward the light. The UFO drops an abducted woman — talk to her and offer help [14][2].
Go back to her car. The UFO comes back and abducts you, and Lucia calls three days later [14][2].
The spawn is random and not guaranteed. If the car is not there, return another night [2][14].

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.

disputes.a: PowerPyx gives an exact method: on a bike, kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds, in Vice City or Ocean Beach [2].
disputes.b: KeenGamer says the precise method is still being confirmed, and TimeSaver says it is not confirmed yet [10][11].
disputes.call: Follow PowerPyx's method — it is the only concrete one. A bike on Ocean Beach is the easiest setup.

trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The only concrete method any guide gives: get on a bike, ride through Vice City or Ocean Beach, and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. One of five unconfirmed trophies — the method is a lead, not a guarantee.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

steps.t: Get on a bike in Vice City or Ocean Beach [2][10].
Kick pedestrians with Square as you ride past them [2][10].
You need 10 kicks within 60 seconds [2][10].
The precise method is still being confirmed — KeenGamer and TimeSaver both say no guide has confirmed it [10][11].
If it does not pop, try a busier stretch of Ocean Beach at a different time [2][10].

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. After Chapter 3's Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), the Dye Pack Jammer unlocks. Rob banks and payday loan stores, then bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani pays the most. The total is cumulative across the whole game, and the 100% checklist wants the same $250,000.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

steps.t: Finish Chapter 3's "Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew)" to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer [2][10].
Rob banks and payday loan stores to collect marked bills [2][10].
Bring the marked bills to a fence. Yasmani pays the most [2][10].
The total is cumulative — $250,000 across the whole game. The 100% checklist wants the same $250,000 [3][10].
Bank vaults and payday loan jobs are the biggest sources of marked bills [2][10].
Keep robbing as you free-roam after the story until the total hits $250,000 [2][10].
The trophy pops at $250,000 laundered [2][10].

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way to burn money. The total is cumulative across every shop in the game — 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear, 18 hair and beauty, 11 tattoo and 15 electronics stores.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

steps.t: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops. The total is cumulative [2][10].
Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way to spend it [2][10].
Shop counts: 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing, 17 footwear, 18 hair and beauty, 11 tattoo, 15 electronics [2][10].
Buy the expensive gear first — high-end guns and full car mods move the total fast [2][10].
Money you spend on properties does not count here — this is shops only [2][10].
The trophy pops at $100,000 spent [2][10].

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 purchasable garages plus 4 story garages, for $160,000 in total. Garage buying opens after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses), through the Vice City Real Estate app.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

steps.t: Finish the Chapter 2 mission "Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses)" first — garage buying opens after it [2][8].
Open the Vice City Real Estate app to buy garages [2][10].
8 garages are purchasable, plus 4 story garages — 12 in total [2][10].
The total cost is $160,000 [2][10].
Buy them as you earn money from heists and vaults [2][10].
The trophy pops when the last garage is bought [2][10].

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app opens after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses) — drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register. Moses only accepts vehicles without trackers at first; from Chapter 3 you can register Standard Tracker cars at a Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot

steps.t: Finish the Chapter 2 mission "Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses)" — the Scooter Bros app opens after it [2][8].
Steal a vehicle and drive it to Moses in Port Gellhorn [2][10].
Choose "Respray", then "Register" [2][10].
Moses only accepts vehicles without trackers at first [2][10].
From Chapter 3, register Standard Tracker cars at a Pay 'n' Spray instead [2][10].
Registering costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes [2][10].
The trophy pops at the 10th registration [2][10].
